name: dev-flow
description: Drives a dev workflow end-to-end (features or fixes): brainstorm → spec → plan → create GitHub issue → execute (TDD) → review → doc-fix → PR → manual merge → close-out. Depends on superpowers for brainstorming, writing-plans, and test-driven-development.
